# CONTRACT

Normative **Active Stage Truth** compiled from Current Implementation Source + Current Reality. This is not a second Product Design source or project history. Delete unused optional sections rather than inventing content.

- Core Generation: [opaque Planning generation; MUST match ACCEPTANCE and WORKPLAN]
- Controller Revision: [MUST match project-local EXECUTION header]

## Source Basis / Authority — when relevant

- Source identity / revision / currentness: [required when material]
- Authority / source / precedence / semantic role: [Normative / Fact-Evidence / Reference-Suggestion / Open when material]
- Revision delta / accepted must-preserve baseline: [when material]
- Durable locator / reacquisition condition: [when later Stage semantics may need reopening]
- Reopen / reconfirmation trigger: [when material]

If authorized Goal Horizon continues beyond this Stage, the source identity/currentness + retrieval route above act as the **Continuation Anchor** unless enough remaining Horizon semantics are already preserved below.

## Goal Horizon / Normal Return — when relevant

- Current authorized Goal Horizon: [overall CURRENT scope]
- Normal Return Point: [when whole Horizon is complete]
- Remaining authorized Horizon after this Stage: [only enough to prevent premature completion / preserve dependency]

Inactive authorized Horizon is not FUTURE merely because it is outside this Execution invocation.

## Active Implementation Stage

- Stage / Waypoint: [bounded subset]
- Entry basis: [prior accepted state / Current Reality when material]
- Exit: [observable Stage completion reference]

- [Outcome this Stage contributes/restores/preserves]
